SessionStart matcher=startup|resume #8ac: Hands the work to a detached child and exits 0 at once. One child runs at a time: a start that finds another one running exits quietly. The child moves the claude-settings local main to origin/main by fast-forward only (in a tree that holds main, unless a tracked change blocks it, or by ref), then runs merge/install_from_main.sh from the clone only when the live pin is not at origin/stable. With no origin/stable it pins local main and writes one WARN line naming stable; CLAUDE_SETTINGS_REF=main pins local main with no WARN. It never stashes, resets or forces in your trees; install_from_main.sh switches only the pin, and never one with tracked changes. Does nothing in cloud sessions. A failed fetch, move, blocked fast-forward or pin install writes one line to the install log, with its own reason. The session that starts it can load before the child ends; a session that starts after the child ends sees the move.
